title: Strategy Consultant
reasons: keywords: strategy, consulting, transformation, commercial, revenue, growth, stakeholder, problem solving +4
description: About Accenture Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com . At Accenture, our Supply Chain & Engineering (SC&E) team is growing and looking for experienced Consultants to help leading organizations solve complex operational, engineering, and transformation challenges. Our work spans Local Content & Procurement, Capital Projects, Operations Readiness, Digital Twins & Digital Engineering, and Asset Management . As a Management Consultant in Supply Chain & Engineering , you will work with multidisciplinary teams to support clients across strategy, transformation, and implementation. Depending on your experience, you will typically specialize in one or more SC&E capability areas , while gaining exposure to the broader practice. You will lead project workstreams, conduct structured analysis, engage with client stakeholders, and develop practical recommendations that improve operational and business performance. Key Responsibilities Lead project workstreams and manage analysis, activities, and deliverables. Solve complex business and operational challenges using qualitative and quantitative analysis. Develop strategies, operating models, roadmaps, and business cases . Apply digital technologies, AI, analytics, and engineering solutions to improve performance. Support implementation by defining initiatives, milestones, risks, dependencies, and performance measures. Support business growth through client discussions and practice-development initiatives. Our Capability Areas Consultants will typically bring experience in at least one of the following: Local Content & Government Procurement: Local content strategy, localization, supplier development, procurement transformation, and performance frameworks. Capital Projects: Project governance, PMO, project controls, portfolio management, risk, and capital program performance. Operations Readiness: Readiness planning, operating models, mobilization, testing, handover, go-live, and operational acceptance. Digital Twins & Digital Engineering: Digital twin strategy, use cases, engineering data, BIM, IoT, AI, analytics, and digital engineering transformation. Asset Management: Asset strategy, maintenance, reliability, lifecycle planning, performance management, and digital enablement. We Believe You Have Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Technology , or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant experience in consulting or an industry role related to one or more SC&E capability areas. Strong structured problem-solving and analytical skills . Experience developing presentations, analyses, and recommendations for senior stakeholders. Strong communication, teamwork, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work effectively across business, operational, technical, and engineering teams. A strong interest in working at the intersection of business, operations, engineering, and technology . A commercial mindset and willingness to contribute to proposals and client development. What Is in It for You Work on major transformation, infrastructure, asset, and engineering programs. Build deep expertise in your chosen capability while gaining exposure across SC&E. Access Accenture's global network of industry, engineering, technology, and functional specialists. Develop your skills through structured learning, certifications, coaching, and challenging client engagements. Work in multidisciplinary teams combining strategy, operations, engineering, data, and technology. Why join us? We offer a transparent, fast paced career progression, with a focus on your strengths and continuous coaching from senior colleagues You will benefit from working alongside Accenture experts who are solving some of the biggest industry challenges with innovative thinking and pioneering tools Flexible work arrangements and a range of benefits including competitive rewards You will have access to state-of-the-art technology that will give you the opportunity to deepen your existing skills even as you help create the latest business trends You will also have opportunities to make a difference to the communities in which we work and live Way Forward: If this sounds like the ideal role, career, and company for you, click below to apply. To learn more about life @AccentureMiddleEast, follow us on social media and keep up with our latest news.
